people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”
translations.bsb: And when the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, “My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?”
translations.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
translations.asv: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
